<title level="1" right="Action">[Rolling Knockdown](/Actions.aspx?ID=2131) <actions string="Two Actions" /></title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 40

</column>

---

Your earth elemental rolls along the ground like a bowling ball and knocks a foe over. It Strides up to 10 feet then makes a fist Strike. If it hits, the target is also knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31).
name: Rolling Knockdown
